Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 433 AM EDT Tue Oct 20 2026

- Dry weather with mild afternoon highs and cool morning lows will 
  persist into the weekend.

&&

.AVIATION...

Satellite imagery and in-situ observations highlight expansion of 
shallow fog expanding from the Saginaw Bay inland due to moisture 
advection from northeast flow coupled with light winds and clear 
skies. Fog is holding just north of KMBS but a southward expansion 
remains possible prior to daybreak which would bring visibility 
restrictions down to IFR-LIFR. Hi-res model output also highlights 
the possibility of fog pushing into KFNT closer to 11-13Z, but given
this timing coincides with sunrise, confidence is lower regarding 
this and any subsequent visibility restrictions. Any fog observed 
will burn off after sunrise, leading to clear skies and light winds 
for the remainder of the day. 

D21/DTW Convection... Thunderstorms are not forecast through the TAF 
period.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* None.
